annotations.title: Run full AX Audit with simulation and benchmark

description: Run the full AX Audit on a URL — the same real AR-* checks as scan_site (the exact check count grows over time, so it is intentionally not pinned here), plus an agent-simulation task (e.g. "find pricing") and an industry benchmark percentile, with the result persisted server-side. Returns a report_id that can be used to retrieve the same report later without re-scanning. No authentication required.

industry.description: Industry to benchmark against, e.g. saas. Defaults to "saas".

name: run_full_audit
